summary: Enhance your skills in data analytics with our course focused on financial fraud prevention. Learn techniques to detect and combat fraud effectively.
lede: Data analytics for financial fraud prevention helps professionals move beyond manual sampling by applying systematic techniques to identify, mitigate, and investigate suspicious activity across financial systems. This course provides hands-on practice with lead-digit analysis, Z-score outlier detection, supervised classification, link analysis for collusion detection, and automated Suspicious Activity Report workflows. You will learn to combine SQL-based queries, Python-driven visualisation, and disparate data sources into a unified monitoring framework covering accounts payable, payroll, and procurement. The course also introduces advanced machine learning architectures while addressing practical constraints such as data silos, limited forensic budgets, data governance, and ethical reporting.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals tasked with safeguarding financial assets and ensuring regulatory compliance through data-driven oversight.
modules: Financial Fraud Landscape and Data Foundations
Statistical Anomaly Detection and Benford’s Law
SQL for Fraud Detection and Rule-Based Testing
Text Mining and Unstructured Data Analysis
AML, KYC, and Regulatory Compliance Analytics
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of financial accounting principles and basic experience with data manipulation tools such as Microsoft Excel. Familiarity with SQL or basic statistical concepts is beneficial but not required, as the course provides the necessary technical grounding for all analytical exercises.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
